scope: Thin CLI and StockMesh Skill clients over the shared public synthetic application capability facade.

criteria.expected: One transport-neutral capability facade owns P5 command validation and envelopes; Fastify and CLI delegate to existing application/search services rather than reimplementing domain logic.
CLI returns one machine-readable JSON envelope on stdout, sends diagnostics to stderr, and uses stable exit codes without exposing SQL or database paths.
CLI and Web capability routes return the same selected Position, evidence cutoff, profile, Method, Analysis, branch, and Evaluation identities for equivalent synthetic requests.
An explicit historical or hypothetical Position can be inspected and analyzed without later Evidence, sibling branches, or current-profile state leaking into its context.
CLI can list, pin, fork, replay, and resume retained branches while preserving purpose, realization, frozen context, Main Line, parents, and siblings.
Position comparison returns explicit Node, Relation, Flow, and State identifier deltas and never invents a universal scalar score.
Contributor access can stage one synthetic Evidence item idempotently but exposes no review, accept, profile-apply, arbitrary SQL, or direct canonical-write capability.
The StockMesh Skill routes supported intents to the CLI, requires explicit Position/branch identities where relevant, and instructs the Agent not to read SQLite or supply a second analysis authority.
The repository Skill validates as a Codex skill and contains no credential, private locator, case material, raw dossier, or autonomous action instruction.
Unknown capabilities, malformed JSON, missing identifiers, invalid times, and inaccessible identities fail closed with bounded errors and no partial canonical mutation.
The P5 clients add no runtime dependency or service boundary and preserve exact-version, release-age, license, public/private, and provider-neutral architecture controls.
Full P0-P5 tests, typecheck, build, license, Skill validation, compatibility validators, repository/public-boundary gate, browser workflow, and diff check pass before GitHub Flow merge.
